svg.aria-label: From a change to a release. make check: gofmt, vet, staticcheck, shellcheck and go test -race. make test-windows: every package again as a Windows program. CI: Windows Server 2022 and 2025, Windows on Arm, fuzzing, and real stops on WSL 2. A vX.Y.Z tag: builds the zips, Scoop and the demo image, then installs them.
